liscor_dungeon_rift.name: The rift in the snow

canon_ref.note: Mrsha runs a long way over hills from Liscor to reach it; the text gives no direction or distance. Halrac says it drops well over a hundred feet; Klbkch says it falls into the heart of the dungeon. Map: dungeon_rift (a guess, south of the floodplains).

liscor_dungeon_rift.summary: A dark crack in the ground, nearly hidden by snow behind the crest of a low slope some way from Liscor. Nobody knew of it before Mrsha fell in. It drops straight into the dungeon under the city, and people argue whether it is a danger or a new way in.

north_izril.name: Northern Izril

canon_ref.note: The Human north of the continent, beyond the High Passes. Used for Rags' events at unnamed towns and camps (3.28G, 3.29G). No map.

north_izril.summary: The Human-ruled northern half of Izril, north of the High Passes: cities such as Invrisil and Celum, noble lands and wide snowy wilds where Goblin tribes roam in winter.

tremborags_mountain.name: Tremborag's mountain

canon_ref.note: A lone mountain north of the High Passes, near Invrisil (3.26G). Not the Goblin lair of Book 2 (goblin_mountain_lair). No map.

tremborags_mountain.summary: A lone mountain in the north of Izril, hollowed into an old Dwarf city, where the Great Chieftain Tremborag rules thousands of Goblins. It has halls, an armoury, a strict pecking order and a hall where captives are held.

celum_liscor_road.name: The road south of Celum

canon_ref.note: The wagon is more than 30 miles south of Celum on the way to Liscor when the old man stops it. No map.

celum_liscor_road.summary: The long snowy road from Celum south toward Esthelm and Liscor, where wagons and armies alike pass in winter.

village_of_the_dead.name: The village of the dead

canon_ref.note: Unnamed in the text. Zombies rise again after they fall, and Ghouls hunt there. No map.

village_of_the_dead.summary: A dead Human village in the north held by zombies that will not stay down and by Ghouls. Rags' tribe loses many warriors there.

hedault_house.name: Hedault's house

canon_ref.note: A stone house in Invrisil with wards that keep talk private. No map.

hedault_house.summary: A warded stone house in Invrisil where an [Enchanter] appraises and repairs magic items. He takes visitors only from dawn to dusk.

invrisil_merchants_guild.name: Merchants' Guild of Invrisil

canon_ref.note: Truth stones are used to swear oaths there. No map.

invrisil_merchants_guild.summary: The Merchants' Guild of Invrisil, where big orders are placed and sworn on truth stones.
